ext_browser_desc: Navigate, read, and interact with the web via Hecos
ext_browser_mode_desc: Choose how Hecos interacts with the browser. CDP mode is recommended because it uses your real Chrome with active sessions.
ext_browser_cdp_desc: Hecos hooks into your Google Chrome invisibly. It sees your extensions, login sessions, and bookmarks.
ext_browser_app_desc: Hecos uses a dedicated Chromium browser, separated from yours. No access to passwords or saved sessions.
ext_browser_app_info: Requires Playwright — the browser will be downloaded automatically on first start.
ext_browser_adblock_desc: Blocks ad networks to speed up page loading.
ext_browser_vision_mouse_desc: Hecos uses AI to see the screen and moves the real mouse. Not available while Hecos is "driving".
ext_browser_timeouts_desc: Adjust the maximum wait times for browser operations.
ext_browser_timeout_nav_desc: Max time to load a page or launch.
ext_browser_timeout_action_desc: Max time for clicks, typing, and interactions.
ext_browser_timeout_wait_desc: Time for state checks (e.g., DOM loading).
ext_browser_timeout_thread_desc: Total max time a task can block the thread.
ext_browser_routing_desc: These system instructions tell the AI how to use the browser. Modify them to alter its behavior. Leave blank to use manifest defaults.
